reviews.author: Casandra D…
reviews.body:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience with Amanda at Glamour Nail Studio! She did an amazing job on my acrylic nails with gel French tips: they came out absolutely pristine and elegant, exactly the look I was hoping for. She was efficient, detail-oriented, and made sure everything looked perfect.

I also had a gel pedicure, and it turned out beautifully. The manicure included a relaxing finishing touch with a choice of scented cuticle oil, which was a really nice extra. The studio itself is clean, welcoming, and has a great atmosphere.

If you're looking for beautiful, elegant nails and excellent service, I highly recommend Amanda at Glamour Nail Studio!
